title: Recurring tasks on the timeline
summary: Recurring tasks now show every future occurrence on the timeline, so repeating work is part of the plan.
content:
Recurring tasks now show every future occurrence on the timeline, so repeating work is part of the plan.

  • Future occurrences appear as lighter bars
  • Drag one occurrence to move just that date
  • Works with weekly, monthly and custom schedules

title: Faster boards for big projects
summary: Boards with thousands of tasks now open about three times faster, and dragging stays smooth.
content:
Boards with thousands of tasks now open about three times faster, and dragging stays smooth.

  • Columns load as you scroll
  • Card counts update instantly
  • Less memory use on older laptops

title: Calendar sync time zones
summary: Tasks synced to calendars no longer shift by a day for people west of UTC.
content:
Tasks synced to calendars no longer shift by a day for people west of UTC.

  • All-day tasks stay all-day
  • Existing subscriptions update automatically

title: Portfolio status notes
summary: Project owners can add a short note when they change a project's status, and it shows in the weekly digest.
content:
Project owners can add a short note when they change a project's status, and it shows in the weekly digest.

  • Notes appear in the portfolio view
  • Status history is kept for every project

title: Smarter CSV import
summary: The importer now recognises more date formats and suggests column matches based on your headers.
content:
The importer now recognises more date formats and suggests column matches based on your headers.

  • Detects day-first and month-first dates
  • Remembers your last column mapping

title: Guest access to comments
summary: Guests can now see comment threads on tasks shared with them, as intended.
content:
Guests can now see comment threads on tasks shared with them, as intended.

  • No change to what guests can edit
